verdict.rationale: Windows developer docs offer one thin first-party mention of a way to explore controls and inspect working code, which loosely matches an interactive reference with runnable examples, but only for UI controls. No broader interactive API reference is evidenced, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: a documented interactive API reference covering the Windows APIs, examples that are explicitly runnable in-browser or in a sandbox, detail on how examples are executed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Explore controls, inspect working code, and use tools that help you create Windows apps.
